subject: Big Data Analytics (BDA)
chapter: Unit 1 - Introduction to Big Data Analytics

topics.topic: Big Data Fundamentals - 5 Vs, Data Sources & Formats

questions.question: Classify a social media dataset according to the five Vs of Big Data, using suitable examples for each characteristic.
Classify web logs, customer reviews, transaction records, images, and sensor readings according to their data sources and formats.

topics.topic: Traditional Systems vs Big Data Platforms & Architecture

questions.question: Compare traditional data-processing systems with distributed Big Data platforms in terms of scalability, storage, and processing speed.
Compare and contrast traditional data processing with Big Data approaches.
Select an appropriate storage and processing approach for an organization that generates large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
A retail company receives millions of transactions, product reviews, and website clicks daily. Analyze the limitations of its traditional database and recommend a suitable Big Data architecture.
Identify the six phases of the Data Analytics Life Cycle in a customer-retention project and state the primary activity performed in each phase.
Apply all six phases of the Data Analytics Life Cycle to a customer-sentiment analysis project for an e-commerce company. Specify the activity and expected output of each phase.
Apply the Data Analytic Life Cycle to a customer sentiment analysis case study.
Demonstrate the role of data preparation in improving the quality of an online retail sales dataset.

A data science team builds a customer-churn model using a dataset containing missing values, duplicate records, and inconsistent formats. Analyze how poor data preparation could affect model performance.
Analyze the risks of poor data preparation and their impact on model accuracy.
A dataset contains missing values, outliers, inconsistent date formats, and duplicate customer records. Develop a preprocessing procedure and justify the treatment selected for each issue.
Given a dataset with missing values and outliers, demonstrate a strategy for cleaning and preparing the data.

topics.topic: Model Planning, Model Selection & Feature Selection

questions.question: Apply suitable model selection criteria to select an appropriate analytical model for a given Big Data Analytics problem during the Model Planning phase.

A bank plans to use customer transaction data for credit-risk prediction. Evaluate the factors that should guide model selection, including accuracy, interpretability, data volume, and computational cost.
A recommendation system uses browsing history and past purchases. Analyze the importance of feature selection and its influence on computational efficiency and recommendation quality.

A company observes that its machine-learning model performs well on training data but poorly on new customer records. Evaluate possible causes and recommend improvements to model selection, validation, and deployment.
A business uses dashboards to communicate customer behavior to its management team. Select suitable visualization methods and justify their use during the Communicate Results phase.
Analyze the role of visualization techniques in the Communicate Results phase.
A financial institution deploys a fraud-detection model. Analyze the security, monitoring, and maintenance activities required during the Operationalize phase.
Analyze the relationship between web data and real-time Big Data analytics.
Discuss the importance of anomaly detection techniques in Big Data fraud prevention.

A bank receives transaction events continuously and must flag suspicious payments within seconds. Design a real-time fraud-detection workflow covering ingestion, preprocessing, analysis, alert generation, and monitoring.
A healthcare organization combines patient records, laboratory reports, medical images, and wearable-device readings. Analyze the challenges of data integration, privacy, storage, and preprocessing.
A company collects customer location and browsing information for personalized services. Evaluate the privacy, consent, security, and ethical issues involved in the analytics process.
An organization plans to migrate its analytics workload from local servers to a cloud platform. Develop a migration strategy addressing scalability, storage, cost, data security, and availability.
Develop a plan to integrate cloud computing for scalable Big Data analytics in an organization.
Design a Big Data analytics solution for an online shopping platform to recommend products using browsing history, purchase records, ratings, and customer reviews.
Apply Big Data analytics to optimize e-commerce recommendations.
